stem: How are the train and the speaker similar?

options.label: A
options.text: Like the train that has a schedule to keep, the speaker has an approaching responsibility.

options.label: B
options.text: Like the train that brays and boasts, the speaker acts in an overly proud manner.

options.label: C
options.text: Like the train that travels at midnight, the speaker prefers to work during the night.

options.label: D
options.text: Like the train that stays on a straight course, the speaker avoids change.
